title: TileMapLayer tile placement preview does not correctly inherit the project default texture filter
body: ### Tested versions - Godot v4.8.dev6.official [8898c2b3d] - Godot v4.7.2.stable.steam [ed1daf0bf] ### System information Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (1920x1200 @ 165.00 Hz, 2560x1440 @ 180.00 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - AMD Ryzen 9 7940HX with Radeon Graphics (32 threads) - 31.21 GiB memory - WASAPI (96000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When the project default texture filter is set to **Nearest** and the TileMapLayer texture filter is set to **Inherit**, placed pixel-art tiles look correct, but the tile placement preview under the mouse cursor is still blurry, as if it were using **Linear** filtering. I expect the placement preview to inherit the project setting and use Nearest filtering, just like the placed tiles. Setting the TileMapLayer texture filter explicitly to Nearest makes the preview sharp. This report is being resubmitted at the maintainer's request in #123666. Inherit: blurry preview Explicit Nearest: sharp preview Back to Inherit: blurry preview again ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a new project and set **Project Settings > Rendering > Textures > Canvas Textures > Default Texture Filter** to **Nearest**. 2. Add a **TileMapLayer** node to the scene and leave its texture filter set to **Inherit**. 3. Assign a **TileSet** to the node, add a pixel-art tile texture, and create tiles. 4. Select a tile in the **TileMap** panel and place a few tiles in the scene. 5. Hover over an empty cell beside the placed tiles and compare the placement preview with them: the preview is blurry, while the placed tiles remain sharp. 6. Change the TileMapLayer texture filter to **Nearest** and hover over an empty cell again. The preview becomes sharp. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [tile-preview-filter-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32463733/tile-preview-filter-mrp.zip)
